summary: The U.S.-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz drained safe-haven demand, pulling gold sharply lower while hawkish Fed signals — with a December rate hike now priced near 42% odds — have bolstered real yields and the dollar, adding a second headwind.
tweet: Iran ceasefire drains gold's war premium while a hawkish Fed keeps real yields and the dollar elevated — two simultaneous headwinds holding gold deep in Fear even as stocks find their footing.
